name: savvy-progress
description: Live progress above the prompt and in a pane (/savvy-progress) for shell commands and subagents: what runs now, what finished or failed, elapsed time, steps and tokens.

autoOpen.title: Open the progress pane
autoOpen.description: agents: open the pane when a subagent starts (once per prompt); never: only with /savvy-progress

summarize.title: Summarize commands without a description
summarize.description: model: ask Haiku for a few words on each shell command that came without a description (a small model call each, counted in the session's usage); off: name the programs it runs instead
